scope: Desktop execution-progress discoverability only; native runtime unchanged. UI event-order tests are synthetic and kept separate from real DeepSeek Flash execution.
changes: Current native update_plan step count and current step remain visible above the composer, outside collapsed activity. Expand to see the real checklist.
Waiting approval/response, stopping/interrupted, failed/disconnected, incomplete terminal turn and actual completion use distinct native-derived statuses.
No plan means no invented step count; no elapsed-time percentage. A new turn cannot reuse the last turn's progress.
Current progress has one visible home; earlier turns retain their history cards. Updates preserve expanded state, summary focus and history scroll.
Plan confirmation requests native update_plan updates, without implementing a new agent loop or guaranteeing model obedience.
Permanent native deletion clears the corresponding local progress text.
Existing home/thread-scoped cache retained; buffered progress events must survive history hydration (app hook owned by root).

preservedEarlierRuns.result: Real native workflow 3/3; before removing duplicate current progress cards and tightening CSS spacing.

Test assertion rejected pwd/rg --files during Plan. Actual native Plan permits read-only metadata investigation; no content read or business execution occurred. Test boundary corrected; not a product bug.
Same overstrict test classification rejected python3 --version metadata; test corrected without treating it as business execution.
Screenshot waiter caught an instant cat command that ended before inspection, then the test cleaned up. Waiter now requires the bounded 12-second command; not a native execution failure.
Waiting-approval UI assertion failed before app renderRequests hook was integrated; final UI suite passes.
11 UI assertions passed; final safety assertion incorrectly treated config/read as mutation. Narrowed to actual writes; no native mutation.
11 UI assertions passed; final suite adds deletion-cache cleanup as the 12th assertion.

limits: Native Plan allows read-only investigation and is not a hard security approval gate. Tool execution permissions still use native approval policies.
Progress is native reported step state, not a guaranteed execution-time estimate or durable workflow program counter.
A model can omit or revise update_plan; the frontend does not invent progress.
Refresh restoration uses already observed browser-local native plan snapshots and genuine incoming events. No cross-browser server-side progress reconstruction was added.
